title: Beanconqueror Brew Daily Event Volume
dataSources: Beanconqueror brews (`beanconqueror:brew`), Acaia brew sessions (`acaia:brew`), Decent Espresso shots (`decent:shot`), Brewfather coffee recipes (`brewfather:coffee`), and tea-timer sessions (`teatimer:session`).
app: Beanconqueror brews, Acaia scale sessions, Decent Espresso shot telemetry, Brewfather coffee recipes, and tea-timer app exports forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=beanconqueror:brew
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(recipe_name) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many Beanconqueror brew events land each day and how many distinct recipe name values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest Beanconqueror brew records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct recipe name values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It warns how much Beanconqueror brew activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
